description: This file defines the 'EmailNotification' entity class for the OrangeHRM system, including its properties, ORM mappings, and constants representing different email notification types.

classes.name: EmailNotification
classes.description: Entity class representing email notifications in the OrangeHRM system, with properties for ID, name, enabled status, and related email subscribers, mapped using Doctrine ORM annotations.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the email notification.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the email notification.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the email notification.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the email notification.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the email notification is enabled.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables the email notification.

methods.name: getEmailSubscribers
methods.description: Retrieves the list of email subscribers associated with this notification.
